name: Smokey
bio: Smokey what can we say about him, he is a real boy he is mischievous and full of energy, he loves to play especially football Smokey is a real character and has a lot of love to give, he is also very vocal and enjoys shouting at me throughout the day, as you might tell he loves his treats and is going to be a big boy. He is also Lunas brother they are completely different but wouldn’t change them.
